principles: critical and matched-decoy cases occur in equal counts within every update
no supervised message target or additive communication bonus
ordinary play remains present throughout training
difficulty and communication density increase without changing the frozen evaluation

stages.name: tactical_stabilization
stages.purpose: learn legal tactical play before increasing communication pressure

stages.name: communication_introduction
stages.purpose: raise aggregate critical/decoy density to 30/30 without a discontinuous jump

stages.name: communication_heavy
stages.purpose: apply sustained information-handoff pressure while retaining 30 percent ordinary play

stages.name: adaptive_self_play
stages.purpose: test retention under the model-controlled current-policy opponent rotation

checkpoint_selection: select once from development metrics after update 120
frozen_policy: the existing rl_v4 frozen OOD evaluation remains unopened and byte-identical
